```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Conciliación bancaria</h1><div class="tf-muted">Compara el saldo calculado con el saldo informado por el banco.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div><div class="tf-card"><form id="recn-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="recn-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="recn-date" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Saldo informado por banco ($)</label><input id="recn-bank-balance" type="number" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field" style="display:flex;align-items:end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Conciliar</button></div></form><div id="recn-result" class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem"></div></div><div class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem"><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Cuenta</th><th>Tracker</th><th>Banco</th><th>Diferencia</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead><tbody id="recn-body"></tbody></table></div></div>
```
